cc:Work.dc:title: King Concept (MONOLITH Edition - v1.0)
cc:Work.dc:description: The king of the tall MONOLITH concept set, drawn to stand beside Dennis's castle-concept.svg: a stern head with long hair under a crenellated crown and spire, a gold halo with its horizon bar, and an art-deco block whose arched niche holds a ringed glass orb above a glowing channel that runs down into the plinth's door.
